comment: Cheap role variation for the blocked hero-defender recipe of uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_acid. A hostile ochre jelly gets the same bounded wait sequence against a human Monk. C still routes the natural AT_ENGL AD_ACID attack through mhitu.c:gulpmu; ordinary expulsion's mspec_used cooldown is decremented by monmove.c:mon_regen before the next attack. This recipe does not establish mhitm_ad_acid hero-defender coverage.
